desc: Implement coordinate compression and Fenwick trees supporting point updates, prefix sums, and kth-value lookup.
Compute every length-\(x\) window’s minimum equalization cost using the Fenwick structures, including negative values and duplicate elements.
Implement the cardinality DP for exactly \(k\) non-overlapping windows, with correct back-to-back indexing and unreachable-state handling.
Validate the complete `Solution.minOperations` implementation against both examples and relevant edge cases.
